definitions.full: H1409. gad II. [ גַּד ] 1. noun [masculine] fortune, good fortune (Arabic id. , Aramaic גַּדָּא , ) — Gen 30:11 בּגד Kt, i.e. בְּגָד ( גָד֑ בָּא Qr), ᵐ5 ἐν τύχῃ , by or with good fortune. 2. proper name, masculine god of fortune (Arabic We Skizzen iii. 171 ; גד named often in Phoenician & Aramaic inscriptions, & found in Phoenician & Aramaic proper name, Bae Rel 76 f. Nö ZMG 1888, 479 ; see especially Siegf JPTh 1875, 356 ff. ) — with לְ + article לַגַּד Isa 65:11 compare Che.
